WITH input_values AS (SELECT $1::text AS token, $2::text AS chat_id, NULLIF($3::text, '') AS user_id, NULLIF($4::text, '') AS username),
claimed AS (
  UPDATE triage.tenant_pairing_tokens p SET consumed_at = now(), consumed_chat_id = i.chat_id
  FROM input_values i WHERE p.token = i.token AND p.consumed_at IS NULL AND p.expires_at > now() RETURNING p.ticket_id, p.tenant_email
), chat AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.tenant_chats (telegram_chat_id, telegram_user_id, telegram_username, tenant_email, active_ticket_id)
  SELECT i.chat_id, i.user_id, i.username, c.tenant_email, c.ticket_id FROM claimed c CROSS JOIN input_values i
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET active_ticket_id = EXCLUDED.active_ticket_id, tenant_email = EXCLUDED.tenant_email, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
)
UPDATE triage.tickets t SET tenant_chat_id = c.telegram_chat_id FROM chat c WHERE t.id = c.active_ticket_id
RETURNING t.id AS ticket_id, t.ref, t.priority, t.missing_info, t.human_only, t.vendor_status, c.telegram_chat_id AS chat_id;

WITH input_values AS (SELECT $1::text AS chat_id), cfg AS (
  SELECT value AS tenant_profile FROM triage.config WHERE key = 'tenant_telegram'
)
SELECT i.chat_id, c.active_ticket_id, c.pending_intake_body, c.pending_intake_started_at, to_jsonb(t) AS ticket, cfg.tenant_profile
       , coalesce((
           SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(open_ticket) ORDER BY open_ticket.received_at DESC)
           FROM (
             SELECT candidate.id, candidate.ref, candidate.issue_summary, candidate.priority,
                    candidate.vendor_status, candidate.status, candidate.received_at
             FROM triage.tickets candidate
             WHERE candidate.tenant_chat_id = i.chat_id
               AND candidate.closed_at IS NULL
               AND candidate.is_maintenance_request IS TRUE
               AND candidate.request_type = 'NEW_ISSUE'
             ORDER BY candidate.received_at DESC
             LIMIT 10
           ) open_ticket
         ), '[]'::jsonb) AS open_tickets
FROM input_values i CROSS JOIN cfg
LEFT JOIN triage.tenant_chats c ON c.telegram_chat_id = i.chat_id
LEFT JOIN triage.tickets t ON t.id = c.active_ticket_id;

parameters.jsCode: function profile(v){try{return typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):(v||{});}catch(_){return {};}} return $input.all().map(item=>{const p=profile(item.json.tenant_profile); const name=p.tenant_name||'Demo Tenant'; const email=p.tenant_email||('telegram:'+item.json.chat_id); const property=p.property||''; const unit=p.unit||''; const tenantText=String(item.json.combined_tenant_text||item.json.text||'').trim(); const context=[`Tenant: ${name}`,property&&`Property: ${property}`,unit&&`Unit: ${unit}`,email&&!email.startsWith('telegram:')&&`Contact: ${email}`,'',tenantText].filter(Boolean).join('\n'); return {json:{source:'telegram',from_address:email,subject:'Telegram maintenance request',body_raw:context,received_at:new Date().toISOString(),attachment_paths:[],msg_id:'<telegram-'+item.json.chat_id+'-'+item.json.message_id+'@maintenance-triage.local>',in_reply_to:null,refs:null,tenant_chat_id:item.json.chat_id,tenant_email:email}};});
const ctx=$("Prepare New Ticket Payload").all(); return ctx.map(item=>({json:{chat_id:item.json.tenant_chat_id,msg_id:item.json.msg_id,tenant_email:item.json.tenant_email}}));

function list(value){try{return Array.isArray(value)?value:(typeof value==='string'?JSON.parse(value):[]);}catch(_){return [];}} return $input.all().map(item=>{const j=item.json; const missing=list(j.missing_info); return {json:{...j,should_notify_manager:Boolean(j.human_only || missing.length===0)}};});

INSERT INTO triage.tenant_chats (telegram_chat_id, pending_intake_body, pending_intake_started_at)
VALUES ($1::text, NULL, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET pending_intake_body = NULL, pending_intake_started_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
RETURNING telegram_chat_id AS chat_id, $2::text AS message_text;

WITH input_values AS (SELECT $1::text AS chat_id, NULLIF($2::text, '') AS tenant_email, $3::text AS body),
upsert_chat AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.tenant_chats (telegram_chat_id, tenant_email, pending_intake_body, pending_intake_started_at)
  SELECT chat_id, tenant_email, body, now() FROM input_values
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET
    tenant_email = coalesce(EXCLUDED.tenant_email, triage.tenant_chats.tenant_email),
    pending_intake_body = left(concat_ws(E'\n', NULLIF(triage.tenant_chats.pending_intake_body, ''), EXCLUDED.pending_intake_body), 4000),
    pending_intake_started_at = coalesce(triage.tenant_chats.pending_intake_started_at, now()),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING telegram_chat_id, pending_intake_body
)
SELECT telegram_chat_id AS chat_id, pending_intake_body FROM upsert_chat;

parameters.query:
WITH input_values AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS ticket_id, $2::text AS outbound_intent, $3::text AS outbound_body,
         NULLIF($4::text, '') AS outbound_external_id, NULLIF($5::text, '') AS delivery_error,
         NULLIF($6::text, '') AS inbound_body, NULLIF($7::text, '') AS inbound_external_id
), inbound_message AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.ticket_messages (ticket_id, channel, direction, intent, body, external_message_id, delivery_state)
  SELECT ticket_id, 'telegram', 'inbound', 'status', inbound_body, inbound_external_id, 'RECORDED'
  FROM input_values WHERE inbound_body IS NOT NULL AND inbound_external_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (channel, direction, external_message_id) DO NOTHING
), outbound_message AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.ticket_messages (ticket_id, channel, direction, intent, body, external_message_id, delivery_state, detail)
  SELECT ticket_id, 'telegram', 'outbound', outbound_intent, outbound_body, outbound_external_id,
         CASE WHEN delivery_error IS NULL THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'FAILED' END, jsonb_build_object('error', delivery_error)
  FROM input_values
  ON CONFLICT (channel, direction, external_message_id) DO UPDATE SET delivery_state = EXCLUDED.delivery_state, detail = EXCLUDED.detail
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id FROM outbound_message;

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item=>{const t=item.json.ticket; const msgId='<telegram-retriage-' + item.json.chat_id + '-' + item.json.message_id + '@maintenance-triage.local>'; return {json:{original_ticket_id:t.id,chat_id:item.json.chat_id,answer_text:item.json.text,external_message_id:'telegram:' + item.json.chat_id + ':' + item.json.message_id,source:'telegram',from_address:'telegram:' + item.json.chat_id,subject:'Clarification for ' + t.ref,body_raw:(t.body_raw || '') + '\n\nTenant clarification: ' + item.json.text,received_at:new Date().toISOString(),attachment_paths:[],msg_id:msgId,in_reply_to:null,refs:null}};});

WITH input_values AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS original_ticket_id, NULLIF($2::text, '') AS child_msg_id, $3::text AS chat_id, $4::text AS body, $5::text AS external_message_id),
child AS (SELECT * FROM triage.tickets WHERE msg_id = (SELECT child_msg_id FROM input_values) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
merged AS (
  UPDATE triage.tickets t SET
    model_json = c.model_json, model_priority = c.model_priority, model_name = c.model_name, model_latency_ms = c.model_latency_ms,
    prompt_tokens = t.prompt_tokens + c.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens = t.completion_tokens + c.completion_tokens,
    is_maintenance_request = c.is_maintenance_request, request_type = c.request_type, priority = c.priority,
    priority_reason = c.priority_reason, override_applied = c.override_applied, override_reason = c.override_reason, human_only = c.human_only,
    trade = c.trade, unit_identifier = coalesce(c.unit_identifier, t.unit_identifier), issue_summary = c.issue_summary,
    habitability_flag = c.habitability_flag, habitability_reason = c.habitability_reason, safety_signals = c.safety_signals,
    access_notes = c.access_notes, accommodation_or_legal_flag = c.accommodation_or_legal_flag, accommodation_or_legal_reason = c.accommodation_or_legal_reason,
    missing_info = c.missing_info, confidence = c.confidence, ambiguity_note = c.ambiguity_note, language = c.language,
    draft_subject = c.draft_subject, draft_body = c.draft_body, vendor_note = c.vendor_note, clarifying_qs = c.clarifying_qs,
    clarification_round = t.clarification_round + 1, vendor_status = 'NOT_STARTED', status = 'NEW'
  FROM child c WHERE t.id = (SELECT original_ticket_id FROM input_values) RETURNING t.*
), child_closed AS (UPDATE triage.tickets SET status='CLOSED', closed_at=now(), thread_root_id=(SELECT original_ticket_id FROM input_values) WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM child)),
message AS (INSERT INTO triage.ticket_messages(ticket_id,channel,direction,intent,body,external_message_id,delivery_state)
  SELECT original_ticket_id,'telegram','inbound','clarification_answer',body,external_message_id,'RECORDED' FROM input_values ON CONFLICT (channel,direction,external_message_id) DO NOTHING),
event AS (INSERT INTO triage.events(ticket_id,actor,action,detail) SELECT id,'system','tenant_clarification_retriaged',jsonb_build_object('round',clarification_round) FROM merged)
SELECT id AS ticket_id, ref, priority, issue_summary, missing_info, human_only, vendor_status, clarification_round, tenant_chat_id AS chat_id FROM merged;
